verdict.rationale: The release notes mention an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, which directly fits the story. LLM-as-a-judge metrics and hallucination and instruction-adherence evaluations also produce AI-generated assessments of logged data, and natural-language feedback can refine those metrics. However, the assistant appears only as a one-line release note, with nothing on what insights or suggestions it surfaces. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the AI Assistant's scope and outputs, evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
